title: alyssum peltarioides subsp. virgatiforme
intro: Alyssum peltarioides subsp. virgatiforme, commonly known as Dwarf White Alyssum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Alyssum peltarioide subsp. virgatiforme include its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
